items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Now, he used to tell me about working for Mike Markel or somebody like that and then we could do something here --

ctx.x: But he couldn't have turned a page with Red. Red had it made and he had been in New York for a long while and I think all the musicians had respect for Red because he had the business in his pocket as far as he was concerned.
Now, he used to tell me about working for Mike Markel or somebody like that and then we could do something here --
